name: kerb-strip
initialPrompt: Create one isolated production game-texture strip for the LIGHT STONE LAWN KERB in image1 city concept; image2 is the matching approved road curb material. STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP DOWN, no perspective. Very tall narrow vertical image, target256x2048 (1:8). ONE single continuous column of EIGHT pale warm ivory-beige rectangular kerbstones from top edge to bottom edge, touching both image borders so it repeats vertically. Each block has a softly beveled edge and subtle mottled limestone texture, hand-painted finish matching references. Thin darker joints, not thick black outlines. Stone column centered at x42%, stone occupies x12%-73% of image width. Left outer margin pure transparent, right margin has only a very short soft semitransparent gray contact shadow falling slightly right/up, which fades fully before right edge; no floor, grass, brown dirt, weeds or another row. No bottom cast shadow, no separate isolated pedestal. Strictly identical width from top to bottom, no taper. Top and bottom cut through matching stone surface, not end caps: top and bottom must tile without a gap or dark end border. Mostly even illumination; stone highlight from lower-left. This border will wrap lawn rectangles at world width0.5 and 4-unit vertical period. Exactly one column, no layout sheet, no text, no labels, no watermark, native alpha outside stone/shadow.
